matrix_recount.method: Read final education-trials.jsonl.gz and locomo-trials.jsonl.gz; compare unique (case_id,variant,budget) identities to suite-declared Cartesian products; independently count budget failures.

education_final_vs_working.comparison: Every field in each final education_priority row, keyed by (variant,budget), compared exactly with the working analysis.

related_completed_prior_check.retained: All other trial fields, audited derived metrics, token/character budgets, planned-duration checks, hashes, component diagnostics and provenance IDs.

semantic_execution.scope: Checked final semantic_execution_audit group counts and identities; full education and one completed LoCoMo shard were also independently audited earlier in this task. No additional model inference was performed for this receipt.

locomo_direct_trial_recomputation.method: Compute means directly from final compressed trial rows selected by category/status and variant/budget; require exact mean and denominator equality with aggregate.locomo_primary.

locomo_budget_reversal.conclusion: Hybrid underperforms legacy at budget 1800 and improves modestly at 3200. The combined education_full configuration does not consistently improve LoCoMo: its 3200 recall is effectively unchanged from legacy while complete-evidence rate is lower. Do not claim universal improvement.

budget_definition_verified.term: Context token budget estimated from serialized Unicode character length
budget_definition_verified.not: Raw-character budget, tokenizer-measured model tokens, or billed tokens

report_review.observed_findings: No numeric mapping or ranking interpretation error found in the reviewed version. Suggested explicit LoCoMo budget-reversal wording and an exact estimated-token formula.
report_review.subsequent_edits: Parent reports both wording changes are now present; this receipt does not claim a second independent review of those edits or visual QA.

limitations: This receipt records completed checks only; it did not rerun the full experiment, the final report writer, model inference, or broad regression tests.

LoCoMo scores measure evidence retrieval and completeness on 1438 valid main-category questions, not official answer-generation accuracy or LLM-judge scores. All 1986 questions remain in the trial corpus.

Education ranking is descriptive within the fixed authored synthetic corpus and its two budgets; it does not establish learning gains, teacher evaluation, unseen-family generalization, or external-system superiority.
The 24-case native-source mechanism probe is post hoc and remains outside the main ranking.
Equal candidate sets do not isolate all source-reader effects: text ranking, source metadata, diagnostic overhead and packing can remain coupled.
Education pooled-probe ratios and family-equal-weight paired intervals are different estimators; LoCoMo intervals are conversation-cluster descriptive intervals, not population claims.
Concurrent jobs shared hardware; recorded latency was not used for performance or quality ranking.
No independent visual verification or deployment verification was performed as part of this final artifact audit.
